security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Find files on Linux by what's in them
bundle.longDescription: Sift is a keyboard-first launcher that searches photos, screenshots, PDFs, notes and code by meaning, exact text, and the text inside images, entirely on your machine. On first launch it downloads Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2 model once (about 435 MB).
